description.value: Twisted Chopsticks Eatery is a Chinese-fusion restaurant on Main Street in Penticton serving bowls, noodles, and stir-fry dishes with an Asian-influenced twist — think Mongolian garlic chicken noodle bowls, ginger beef, and pad thai alongside goat cheese poppers. The menu caters to a range of dietary needs with clearly marked vegan and gluten-free options and tofu substitutes across most mains. Online ordering with 15-minute pickup makes it a practical quick-fuel stop for cyclists rolling through downtown Penticton.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active Chinese eatery at 449 Main St, Penticton with phone +1 250-328-5356 and functional online ordering with pickup. The menu page includes a legend explicitly marking 'gluten free' and 'vegan' items, and tofu versions of main dishes are listed throughout. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone — both sourced from website only; contact_confirmed fields reflect this gap.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant with a functioning website, confirmed address, and online ordering. Useful fuel stop for touring cyclists on Main Street in Penticton.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page legend explicitly marks 'gluten free' and 'vegan' items; tofu versions available for chow mein, pad thai, teriyaki bowl, coconut curry bowl, and Mongolian garlic noodle bowl
